about: Findings the Skylake nightly has seen and accepted (scripts/nightly/README.md, 'The known list'). Each entry matches a finding by kind, and by fnmatch patterns on the deck label or sweep case id (match), the executable (exe) and the cell (cell); a missing pattern matches anything. A matched finding is reported as known and does not turn a night red. Say why in note, and name the issue that will retire it.
